text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
白髪鬼と死の宣告者の特別試合ですね？
ちょうど、もうすぐ始まるところですよ。
text.official_en:
The special match between the White-Maned Demon
and the Reaper is about to start.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえばカイくん、ソレルとうさまに
お会いすることができたって聞いたのだけど。
text.official_en:
Cai, I heard that you were able to have an audience
with my father.
text.real_en:
Kai-kun, I heard that you were able to have an audience
with my father.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
とうさまはどんなご様子だったの？
……そう、それならお変わりはないみたい。
text.official_en: It sounds as if he hasn't changed.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ねえ……カイくん、わたくしは
ソレルとうさまと似ていると思う？
text.official_en: Cai...do you think I look like my father?
text.real_en: Kai-kun...do you think I look like my father?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……カイくんは、ユ・ファス神殿で
ダマスカルの末裔の人たちと会ったのよね？
text.official_en:
While you were at Yu Phas's temple, you met with
some children of Damascar, didn't you?
text.real_en: Kai-kun, you met the descendants of Damascar at Yu Phas's temple, didn't you?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
わたくし……今までずっと不思議に
思っていたことがひとつあるの。
text.official_en:
I've wondered something about them for
a long time...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
かあさまが大帝さまにダグシオン虜囚の助命を
願ったときに、どうしてそれが認められたのか。
text.official_en:
How was my mother able to convince the Divine
Emperor to spare the prisoners?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
かあさまは、あの恐ろしいおじいさまに、
いったい何を差し出したのかって……
text.official_en:
What could she have offered to my grandfather,
that terrifying man?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……ごめんなさい、あなたはまだ子供なのに。
本当はこんな話聞かせちゃだめよね。
text.official_en:
Oh, I really ought not to expose you to this kind of
talk. You are still just a child after all.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
次までには、もう少し母親らしく
いられるように、しっかりしておくから……
text.official_en:
I promise I'll make more of an effort to be more
motherly next time we talk.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ねえ、カイ。ソレルさまって
どんな感じの方だったの？
text.official_en: So, what did you think of the Divine Sovereign?
text.real_en: Hey, Kai. What was Sorell-sama like?

text.jp: <NCA>優しそうだった
text.official_en: <NCA>Say he seemed nice.

text.jp: <NCB>ティアラはどうなの？
text.official_en: <NCB>Ask for her best guess.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……ふうん？　じゃあ、カイは
そんなに悪い印象は抱かなかったのね。
text.official_en:
Well, if you didn't have a bad feeling, then maybe
I should keep a more open mind about him.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あたし……あの人に対しては、
どうしてもいい印象は持てないかな……
text.official_en:
I've been trying to see him in a positive light, yet I
can't help but be bothered by what we've learned.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だって、アウロラさまの件とか、
カストールおじさまの件があるんだもの。
text.official_en:
You know, given how he's treated both your
mom and dad.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それにアウロラさまって……ソレルさまには
あまり会いたがっていないじゃない？
text.official_en:
He didn't seem interested in meeting with
Aurora again, did he?
text.real_en: And Aurora-sama... she doesn't seem very eager to meet Sorell-sama, does she?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしご本人とお話する機会が持てたら、
あたしも印象が変わったりするのかしら。
text.official_en:
I wonder, if we had the opportunity to speak,
whether my poor opinion of him would change.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
大剣闘祭も、ここから
いよいよ本戦が始まるね。
text.official_en: So the main matches are finally about to start, huh?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
カイと一緒に冒険しているうちに、
ぼくも少しは自信がついてきたんだ。
text.official_en:
I admit that when we're on an adventure, you make
me feel confident.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だから、次も勝とうね、カイ。
ぼくも、試合、頑張るからさ。
text.official_en:
I feel like we can probably win the next round, Cai.
I know I'm going to do everything I can to help.
text.real_en:
I feel like we can probably win the next round, Kai.
I know I'm going to do everything I can to help.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、もし次の試合に勝てたとして、その次は
あの怖い女王様と当たるかもしれないんだよね。
text.official_en:
But, if we win the next match, then the one after
that will probably be against that scary lady.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……いやだなあ。
負けてくれないかなあ、あの人達。
text.official_en:
And...I don't like the idea of that. Maybe she'll do us
a favor and lose.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ぼくはタリムーンさんたちのクランを
応援しとくことにするよ。
text.official_en: That's why I'm going to root for Talimun's clan!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まさか、わたしが大剣闘祭の、それも
本戦のアレーナに立つことになるなんて……
text.official_en:
Never thought I'd be in the Heroic Games, let alone
make it to the main matches!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
正直……微塵も想像していなかったわ。
人生って、不思議なものねえ。
text.official_en: Life's weird, huh?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だって、本戦って、３０００組ものクランから
勝ち残った８組で頂点を競うすごい場なのよ？
text.official_en:
Thousands of clans entered, only eight get into the
main matches, and only one can win the top spot!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それこそ、ダグザ帝国史に残るような
出来事なんじゃないかしら。
text.official_en:
I'm willing to bet that these games will go down in
the annals of the Dagdan Empire.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だけど、わたしも御子様のこと、
精一杯お手伝いさせてもらいますからね。
text.official_en: Cai, please let me do everything I can to help you.
text.real_en: Kai, please let me do everything I can to help you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わたしがお仕えしているアウロラ様の為
っていうのはもちろんだけど……
text.official_en:
I'm asking for the sake of Aurora more than
anything else.
text.real_en: Of course, it's also for the sake of Aurora-sama, whom I serve, but...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
御子様の、カストールさんを助けたい想い、
純粋に応援したいって思ってるのが大きいの。
text.official_en: But I really do want to help you save your dad.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だって、家族のために頑張るって、
とっても大切なことだと思うもの。
text.official_en: It's important to do everything you can for family.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの、レダという娘のクランにいる
バッカニアという男……
text.official_en: That man in Leda's clan, Buccar...
text.real_en: That man in Leda's clan, Buccaneer...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
以前から見覚えがある気がしていたのですが、
ようやく思い出すことが出来ました。
text.official_en:
I had a feeling I'd seen him before, and I finally
remembered when that was.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
彼は２０年以上前に、若くしてダグザ帝国の
千人隊長に任命されていた有能な男です。
text.official_en:
More than 20 years ago now, but he was a capable
man. As I recall, he was appointed a pilus prior.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いえ、間違いなどございません。そう、
“バフォスの鬼熊”という二つ名だった筈。
text.official_en:
Yes. I'm sure of it now. He used to go by the name
Demon Bear of Baphos.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その頃は私もまだバルカンとして
駆け出しの若造に過ぎませんでしてな。
text.official_en: Back then, I was nothing more than a vulkan novice.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
世代が近いこともあり、彼のことは
浅からず意識していたものでした。
text.official_en:
But he and I were close in age, so I was vaguely
aware of him.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
彼は確か、ある時期から
シドニア郡に異動になって……
text.official_en: I think he was transferred to Cydonia...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
………………そうか、
あの、シドニアか……
text.official_en: Yes, that's right... It was definitely Cydonia.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
聞いたぜ。お前、
本戦まで勝ち進んだんだってな。
text.official_en: I heard you won your way into the final eight.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……いや、まいったよ。正直なところ、
もうお前の力は俺の予想の上を行ってるようだ。
text.official_en: Well, wow. You're a lot stronger than I'd guessed.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが……
しかしよ………………
text.official_en: That said...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……いや、
やっぱり何でもねえ。
text.official_en: You know what? Never mind. It's nothing.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それより、大事な試合の前に変なもん食って
腹を壊すなんてことがないようにな。
text.official_en:
Just take care of yourself. Don't eat anything that'll
give you a stomachache before a match, OK?
